sentences.text: Alistipes communis was proposed as a novel species for strains isolated from faecal samples of healthy Japanese humans.
Those strains were Gram-stain-negative, obligately anaerobic, rod or coccoid-shaped bacteria assigned to the genus Alistipes in the family Rikenellaceae.
A prospective Swedish cohort study of shotgun metagenomes from 4,685 adults reported Alistipes communis among six species associated with increased risk of incident type 2 diabetes.
In chickens, a study reported that metagenomic and metatranscriptomic integration identified Alistipes communis as a key microbe implicated in abdominal fat deposition.
